endpoints.label: UniProt entry by accession
endpoints.describes: Full UniProtKB record for a single accession — sequence, features, cross-references, GO annotations, keywords.

endpoints.label: UniProt search (gene name, organism, …)
endpoints.describes: Query UniProtKB with the UniProt query language (e.g. 'gene:tp53 AND organism_id:9606'). USE TO RESOLVE GENE NAMES TO ACCESSIONS — required before any InterPro lookup.

endpoints.label: Isoforms for a UniProt entry
endpoints.describes: All annotated isoforms (alternative splicing products) for a given protein.

endpoints.label: UniProt reference proteome
endpoints.describes: Reference proteome record (e.g. UP000000437 for Danio rerio). Lists all proteins for an organism + the underlying assembly.
